Container.Name: buffarr
Container.Overview:
buffarr has two features that share a single Sonarr connection and run in one container: prefetch watches what's playing on Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, or Tautulli and asks Sonarr to grab the next episodes of the show before you catch up to them; unmonitor keeps Sonarr/Radarr from grabbing fake pre-release files by unmonitoring content until its air/release date (plus a configurable delay) has actually passed, then re-monitoring it automatically.
Configure via the variables below, or mount the /config path and drop a config.toml into conf/ instead (see config.example.toml in the repo) -- rotating log files are written to /config/logs/ either way.

Config.Name: Port: Webhook / health
Config.Description: Webhook trigger (/trigger/sonarr, /trigger/radarr) and health-check (/health) HTTP server.

Config.Name: Path: /config
Config.Description: conf/config.toml (optional, see config.example.toml) and logs/ (rotating buffarr.log) live here.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for date calculations, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: DRY_RUN
Config.Description: unmonitor: 1 = log actions only, 0 = apply them. Start at 1 to check the logs before going live.

Config.Name: ENABLE_SONARR
Config.Description: unmonitor: manage Sonarr episode monitoring (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: SONARR_URL
Config.Description: Sonarr base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:8989 -- shared by unmonitor and prefetch.

Config.Name: SONARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Sonarr API key (Settings -> General -> Security).

Config.Name: ENABLE_RADARR
Config.Description: unmonitor: manage Radarr movie monitoring (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: RADARR_URL
Config.Description: Radarr base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:7878.

Config.Name: RADARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Radarr API key (Settings -> General -> Security).

Config.Name: ENABLE_PREFETCH
Config.Description: Enable the prefetch feature (predictive episode fetching from a media server). Requires SONARR_URL/SONARR_API_KEY and the MEDIA_SERVER_* fields below.

Config.Name: MEDIA_SERVER_TYPE
Config.Description: jellyfin, emby, plex, or tautulli.

Config.Name: MEDIA_SERVER_URL
Config.Description: Media server base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:8096.

Config.Name: MEDIA_SERVER_API_KEY
Config.Description: Jellyfin/Emby/Tautulli API key, or Plex server token.

Config.Name: SLEEP_MINUTES
Config.Description: unmonitor: minutes between scheduled passes.

Config.Name: DELAY_MINUTES
Config.Description: unmonitor: minutes after air/release before re-monitoring (can be negative).

Config.Name: SKIP_IF_FILE
Config.Description: unmonitor: skip items that already have a file (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: AUTO_TAG_NAME
Config.Description: unmonitor: tag applied to items buffarr unmonitored.

Config.Name: IGNORE_TAG_NAME
Config.Description: unmonitor: tag that excludes an item from management entirely.

Config.Name: PREFERRED_RELEASE
Config.Description: unmonitor/Radarr: either, digital, or physical.

Config.Name: IGNORE_INCINEMAS
Config.Description: unmonitor/Radarr: ignore cinema release dates (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: RADARR_REMONITOR_WINDOW_DAYS
Config.Description: unmonitor/Radarr: only re-monitor movies released within N days (0=unlimited).

Config.Name: SONARR_REMONITOR_WINDOW_DAYS
Config.Description: unmonitor/Sonarr: only re-monitor episodes aired within N days (0=unlimited).

Config.Name: SEASON_PACK_MODE
Config.Description: unmonitor/Sonarr: re-monitor whole seasons at once instead of episode-by-episode (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: SEASON_PACK_MODE_TAG
Config.Description: unmonitor/Sonarr: tag marking series that use season-pack mode.

Config.Name: MEDIA_SERVER_USERS
Config.Description: prefetch: comma-separated user IDs/names to watch (default: all).

Config.Name: MEDIA_SERVER_LIBRARIES
Config.Description: prefetch: comma-separated library names to watch (default: all), e.g. TV Shows.

Config.Name: PREFETCH_INTERVAL
Config.Description: prefetch: polling interval in seconds.

Config.Name: PREFETCH_NUM
Config.Description: prefetch: episodes to keep available in advance.

Config.Name: PREFETCH_REQUEST_SEASONS
Config.Description: prefetch: prefer season-pack searches over per-episode (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: PREFETCH_APPEND_TO_QUEUE
Config.Description: prefetch: append newly-available episodes to the player's queue -- Jellyfin/Emby/Plex only, experimental (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: PREFETCH_CHECK_AIRED
Config.Description: prefetch: skip episodes that haven't aired yet (1=yes, 0=no).

Config.Name: PREFETCH_CONNECTION_RETRIES
Config.Description: prefetch: retries when initially connecting to Sonarr/media server.

Config.Name: PREFETCH_EXCLUDE_TAG
Config.Description: prefetch: Sonarr tag that excludes a series from prefetching.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
